short.zh: 承接《极简输入》，通过“一键控场”和“舞台预演”两门科目，分别训练现场控制与视觉工程 / 空间预演。
short.en: A workshop series extending Minimal Input through One-Button Show Control for live performance control and Stage Previsualization for visual engineering and spatial previs.

premise.zh: 把视听内容组织成能够进入时间、空间和真实现场的工程，并通过模拟、预演和重复练习持续改进。
premise.en: Organize audiovisual content into systems that can operate across time, space and live performance, then improve them through simulation, previs and repeated practice.

editions.context: MANA follow-up workshop proposal and editorial package
